answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Tailor wool uniform proof sewn into the pressing bench, and every verdict reads the same way: each wool uniform is a fitting record witnessed by the inspector. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. The inspector keeps the 117 POA fee whether the proof passes or not, so 501 proofs drain 58617 POA from the farm and give nothing back. The opal is the mask's face, the oasis is the mask's purse, the karst is the mask's past — and the past is where each farm is caught.
